name: Elapsed Time
source:
[b]Elapsed Time[/b] is a story about miss [custom name] Cian, who gets a chance to work for the royal family in the country of Sensuna! everything is nice and good and then suddenly someone wants to kill the royal family, Alvarma wants a war, pirates slaughter non-humans, and somehow Cian is right in the middle of it all.

discover what's [i]really[/i] going on, find love [i]or[/i] friendship, and [b]die a couple of times![/b]

[From [url=https://majecian.itch.io/elapsed-time-]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[b]Elapsed Time[/b] 是关于[自定义名称] Cian小姐的故事，她有机会为森苏纳国的皇室工作！一切都很好，然后突然有人想要杀死王室，阿尔瓦玛想要一场战争，海盗屠杀非人类，而不知怎的，希安就在这一切的中间。

发现[i]真正[/i]发生了什么，找到爱情[i]或[/i]友谊，然后[b]死几次！[/b]

[来自[url=https://majecian.itch.io/elapsed-time-]Itch.io[/url]]
